payload.text: The capture window has two real bounds and the contract states whether both can be met. VC'S EARLIER FRAMING WAS BACKWARDS AND IS CORRECTED HERE: ambient MITIGATES rather than compounds, because ease is capped at max_ease so the 1.4 multiplier never bites at the cap while dwell's 1.5 always does. Measured -- dwell 2500 ease 3000 gives a window of MINUS 500ms at default pace (the transition outlasts the slide) and PLUS 750ms under ambient. Default pace is the broken case, at any configured ease at or above 2500. vc computed only the ambient case and described it comparatively against a default case never computed: a population of one, reported as a comparison. Once AC-3.11's compile-time cap and refusal land, no config reaching the runtime can have ease >= dwell and this bound is closed at the source. AND THE ROW'S POPULATION IS THE HARNESS, NOT ONE COMMAND: measured 2026-09-09 by snorkeltoast, both bounds are computed and lo >= hi returns None in control and compare, with selftest covering a legal ease-3000 / dwell-2500 windowless config and both sides of the narrowest window (dwell 1301 gives (1100,1100); dwell 1300 gives None), so FLOORS.md's "0 windowless" is a RESULT and not a tautology. BUT cmd_capture and cmd_redproof pass no budget_for and capture at a flat 4000ms, computing no window at all -- two of four commands honour the bounds. Harmless on this reel, whose window is 1100..4520 so 4000 sits inside it, which is why redproof's numbers stand; on a legal dwell-2500 reel the same path photographs the NEXT slide while labelling it this one. Discharged when every capturing command computes the window, not two of them.
